title: Ln (Ln = Gd, Ho, Er, Yb) Butterfly Core-Exhibiting Magnetocaloric Effect and Field-Induced SMM Behavior for Er Analouge

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: [Gd8(μ3-OH)4(L1)4(DEA)4Cl4] solvate (L1 = dianion of 3-(pyridin-2-yl)-N'-((pyridin-2-yl)methylene)-1H-pyrazole-5-carbohydrazide; DEA = diethanolamine dianion); main text writes (DMF)2(MeOH), SI elemental formula C90H122Cl4Gd8N32O22

material_class.structural_family: butterfly Ln8(μ3-OH)4 core with four dianionic pyridyl-pyrazole carbohydrazide ligands and four dianionic diethanolamine coligands

synthesis.procedure: SI: H2L1 (0.0292 g, 0.1 mmol), GdCl3·6H2O (0.1 mmol) and diethanolamine (0.021 g, 0.2 mmol) were dissolved in 3 mL methanol and 3 mL DMF. Trimethylamine (0.02 g, 0.2 mmol) was added as base. The mixture was stirred for 0.5 h and heated in an oil bath at 80 °C for 6 h. The yellow solution was filtered after cooling and left undisturbed. After one week, rod-shaped yellow crystals were collected, washed with a small amount of methanol and dried. Yield 72%. The main text names LnCl3·6H2O (Ln = Gd, Ho, Er, Yb), H2L1, diethanolamine and triethylamine but gives no amounts.
synthesis.time: stirred 0.5 h, then heated 6 h; crystallization about 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction heated in an oil bath, then slow crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after cooling, left undisturbed for one week to give rod-shaped yellow crystals; washed with a small amount of methanol and dried

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is close to eight uncoupled Gd(III) ions and falls sharply only at very low temperature, indicating very weak antiferromagnetic interactions. Magnetization nearly saturates at 2 K and 9 T. A magnetocaloric effect is reported, with a maximum magnetic entropy change of 31.4 J kg−1 K−1 (ΔH = 9 T at 3 K) and a volumetric entropy change of 61.8 mJ cm−3 K−1.

properties.summary: χMT at room temperature matches eight isolated Ho(III) ions and decreases on cooling from crystal-field, mJ depopulation and/or weak antiferromagnetic effects. AC susceptibility shows no frequency- or temperature-dependent out-of-phase signal, so no SMM behavior is observed.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is close to eight isolated Er(III) ions and decreases on cooling. Complexes 2 and 4 show no out-of-phase AC signal, whereas 3 shows field-induced SMM behavior. An Arrhenius fit gives Ueff/k = −36.1 K as printed and τ0 ≈ 1.2×10−8 s. An alternative ln(χ''/χ') analysis gives Ueff about 14–27 K and τ about 1.1×10−6–6.7×10−6 s.
